subject: [hw] R1: V32 accepted (13126/13126; thread/object tables and stop propagation read)
body: Reviewed DONE V32 rev 2 and ran shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh: N2TEST V32 PASS 13126/13126 (direct 2386 + e2e 10740/10714; ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan). I read n2shim_thread.c: the thread table and the object side-table (mutex/cond/sem/rwlock/once) are fixed pools with hash lookup and refcounts, all mutations under g_thr_lock; guest stacks come from a 1 MiB pool via n2a32_mem_alloc and are never unmapped (documented); cond wait holds its cond+mutex, destroy marks dying and frees at refs==0; join/detach use the condvar and a bounded loop with stop_request; stop propagation uses __atomic_store_n(..., RELEASE). No finding. The only remaining issue in this area is V02s side of F8: n2a32_core.c still reads c->stop_request with a plain load, so a cross-thread propagation under TSan is a mixed atomic/non-atomic access; I posted the one-line __atomic_load_n fix to V02. V32 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
